* Add-Ons 2.0.4: This is now the SSOT for Pirate Base spawning.
* 1. Pirate Bases now spawn within a 3D outer shell instead of four corner regions.
* 2. Each axis is bounded to +/-100 km, and valid positions must be 110-140km from the sector center.

Add-Ons 2.0.4: This is now the SSOT for Pirate Base spawning.
1. Pirate Bases now spawn within a 3D outer shell instead of four corner regions.
2. Each axis is bounded to +/-100 km, and valid positions must be 110-140km from the sector center.
3. Rejection sampling succeeds approximately 29% per atetmpt; 30 attempts gives >99.99% success.
Work in 100-meters to avoid integer overflow while retaining 100m resolution.

Doing this at Station Creation time prevents save-scumming in order to get a warlord.
Add-Ons 1.12.2: Anti-savescumming regarding warlord type.
